review_scope: Read-only code, registrations, immutable saved historical evidence and CI status. This record alone is the only write; no evaluator, controller, scope, runtime or old report was changed.
conclusion: No new resource benchmark/controller is required: the existing final performance_v2 worker already measures startup, ingestion, unchanged reingestion, native and actual SDK MCP memory and SQLite storage for the final bound runtime.

The historical round5_resource_diagnostic and round5_resource_audit are deliberately fixed to v0.3.1/v0.3.2 and an already claimed run. They must not be repurposed, replayed or relabeled as final v0.3.3 resource evidence.

The remaining execution prerequisite is the reviewed final source selection, then source-bound interface certificate and formal binding. Storage also needs explicit inspection from the same saved formal raw records because its values are recorded but not included in automatic RESOURCE_FIELDS comparisons.

exact_source_contract.candidate: Not hardcoded to historical C2 or T1. Freezer validates separately committed candidate commit/runtime SHA-256 and complete src/memory_book inventory, exports that exact source, and the formal binding records the resulting source identity.
exact_source_contract.interface_constraint: The new final candidate must still implement exactly the registered T1 optional follow_titles=False schema addition and exact approved description suffix. All other complete schema JSON and instructions must equal v0.3.2 under the frozen projection. An arbitrary changed interface is rejected.
exact_source_contract.guard: Every registered evaluator/helper and historical runtime fixture is hashed; reused helpers/fixtures are checked against the published v0.3.2 tree. Missing/changed binding, source, certificate, packages or evaluator fails closed.

raw_public_input.split_procedure: Sort sample_id, shuffle with random.Random(20261111), reserve first two conversations for development and remaining eight for heldout. Frozen before evaluating retrieval outcomes.
raw_public_input.query_selection: For a bounded run, sort eligible query IDs by SHA256('locomo-query-order-v1:' + query_id), then keep the first max_queries. Selection is independent of question text, answer labels, and outcomes.

registered_formal_execution.input_access_by_review: Only the committed split metadata was read; no LoCoMo raw file, query content or benchmark dataset was downloaded.
registered_formal_execution.query_order: random.Random(51061 + 1009 * round + config_index), equal for paired engines
registered_formal_execution.execution: Sequential fresh worker processes on the same VM/boot. One binding-wide first-attempt hosted claim. Worker intent published before launch and completed report/ledger published before next worker. Started/incomplete workers are never replayed; any allowed untouched suffix continuation requires exact same run/boot identity.
registered_formal_execution.actual_mcp: Official SDK stdio; cache cleared outside each timed call; actual MCP call, full returned envelope and normal cache write costs retained. Separate character and token MCP sessions.
registered_formal_execution.saved_outputs: benchmarks/reports/round5-performance-v2-RUN_ID-RUN_ATTEMPT/report.json.gz, report.summary.json, worker reports, raw/compressed attempt ledgers, claims/checkpoints/completion and preserved failure artifacts.

definitions.runtime_import_ms: Measured around importing memory_book/MemoryBook, before cohort dataset creation.
definitions.fresh_ingestion_ms: Full session ingestion into a new per-worker SQLite database.
definitions.unchanged_reingestion_ms: Second ingestion of the identical full session input; every returned row must be skipped.
definitions.mcp_startup_to_initialize_ms: Actual stdio process/session launch through completed SDK initialize. Character and token sessions measured separately; list_tools is performed afterward.
definitions.native_rss_hwm: /proc/self/status VmRSS and VmHWM after ingestion and after all configurations. These describe the live evaluation worker, including its retained evaluator/input objects; no product-only or phase-attribution claim.
definitions.actual_mcp_rss_hwm: /proc status of the single observed live memory_book child after calls, separately for character/token sessions; missing or ambiguous child fails resource validation.
definitions.initialization_tokens: Both actual cl100k_base/o200k_base schema and instruction costs and candidate-minus-baseline deltas remain preserved by the certificate and every formal session. They are not silently substituted with baseline values.

resource_measurements.aggregation: For each of two cohorts and each field: all four baseline worker samples versus all four candidate samples; arithmetic means and full numeric summaries. No pooling of different resource fields/cohorts.
resource_measurements.automatic_review_rule: change = 100*(candidate_mean/baseline_mean - 1). Exactly zero to zero is 0%; baseline zero to nonzero yields undefined change and requires review. A change greater than 10% plus the existing 1e-9 tolerance requires explicit cause and independent review.
resource_measurements.acceptance_contract: Invalid/incomplete source/payload/ledger/resource samples fail validation. With valid data, accepted = numeric_gate_passed AND no resource_review entries. A passing latency matrix does not bypass a resource increase. There is no automatic override or code path that changes saved acceptance after review.
resource_measurements.independent_disposition: Retain raw samples, every round and the original accepted/resource_review values. Any later cause-and-independent-review disposition under the original plan must be a separate durable decision; never rewrite a failing acceptance or substitute the historical diagnostic.
resource_measurements.artificial_regression_evidence: tests/test_round5_performance_v2.py:test_all_original_numeric_and_resource_gates_remain_required; original tests retain native and separate token-MCP startup/RSS review counterexamples. This review read the fixtures but did not execute them.

storage_contract.definitions: logical_db_bytes = PRAGMA page_count * PRAGMA page_size. db/wal/shm are observed on-disk bytes, zero for absent files. The final boundary follows PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE). Top-level storage_after_mcp_live duplicates the character MCP session and is not a fifth independent sample.
storage_contract.preservation: All four boundaries are written in each completed worker and retained in full report and summary worker records.
storage_contract.automation_limit: Storage values are not in RESOURCE_FIELDS and are not size-compared or separately shape/finite-validated by verify_worker/acceptance. accepted=true is therefore not evidence of an automatically enforced <=10% storage gate.
storage_contract.minimal_followup: In the independent saved-raw formal audit, verify all four boundaries and required fields for every worker and compare all four rounds within each cohort/source. Preserve and explain any storage increase alongside resource review; do not invent a new numeric storage threshold, change the frozen evaluator or launch a separate measurement.

historical_resource_evidence.existing_adverse_evidence: The old round-four +71.97% component setup tree peak and +68.98% native finalization tree peak remain unchanged and are not retrospectively explained by new samples.
historical_resource_evidence.retained_high_water_anomaly: All eight historical product workers reported 373.34375 MiB lifetime high-water alongside roughly 31 MiB sampled query phases. The exact cause is unproven; neither counter is erased or relabeled.
historical_resource_evidence.limits: No v0.3.3 source, no speed/quality/memory-saving/leak conclusion. Sampled phase peaks are lower bounds; missing process/PSS samples remain unavailable. No rerun or repinning of the already claimed historical diagnostic.

release_contract.original_plan: Target v0.3.3 only after the registered gates, complete exact-output/Q2 compatibility and independent review. Pin runtime hash and versioned installers; nine exact-source CI jobs, seven verified release assets and real public installer test. Preserve all prior tags.
release_contract.prerequisites: Formal numeric/exact-payload/resource decision; historical default Hotpot256 compatibility and separate 2048-call char100000 diagnostic; Q2 authored36/Hotpot128 compatibility; independently registered fresh quality/comparator gates; independent evidence review. Resource success alone never authorizes release.
release_contract.executable_release_checks: Exact release branch/version/source SHA; main at the same release commit; newest completed push Tests run at that SHA with exactly nine named successful jobs; committed release notes; one wheel and one sdist with clean installs and byte-exact runtime/reader; three committed versioned installers; manifest and SHA256SUMS; all seven remote assets byte-verified; no prior tag movement; real public default-wheel installation and MCP/client extras tested by published-install.
release_contract.currently_prepared: At the reviewed control commit pyproject and runtime are already 0.3.3, and all three installers refer to v0.3.3.
release_contract.remaining_release_items: There is no committed docs/releases/v0.3.3.md. APPROVED_RUNTIME_SHA256 currently includes only 0.3.0/0.3.1/0.3.2; the selected final 0.3.3 runtime still needs its explicit approved pin. Final exact release-commit CI/assets/public-install are future work.
release_contract.separation: release.py does not parse formal/fresh benchmark acceptance reports. The coordinator must retain the independent registered-gate acceptance decision before starting the release workflow; green functional CI or a generated formal binding is insufficient.

minimal_operation_order: Finish development and independent review, select one final runtime, and commit selection with exact source inventory and immutable evidence references before final/fresh evaluation.
Run the existing source-free freezer once: publish intent, verify source/evidence, generate and publish exact interface certificate, then generate and publish formal binding. Zero corpus calls.

After checking the frozen identities and integration CI, trigger the already registered formal performance_v2 once. Its 16 workers provide the required final-source startup/ingest/reingest/RSS/storage samples together with all 66248 formal calls.

Independently audit saved raw payload/ledger/latency and all 28 automatic resource comparisons, plus storage boundary completeness and changes. Retain every adverse sample and any >10% resource_review entry without rerun or report rewriting.

Complete the separate registered historical lexical/Q2/fresh obligations on the same final runtime and preserve their original gates. Do not relabel old external-component tables or historical resource diagnostics.

Only after the registered acceptance decision, finish the selected runtime approval pin/release notes, obtain nine successful jobs on the exact final release commit, then verify all seven release assets and the real public installer.

integration_ci_observation.interpretation: Eight completed jobs succeeded; macOS installer remained queued. No rerun was requested and this is not represented as 9/9 success.
